searchText: Hey <@755590043632140352> ! Just out of curiosity: what makes people hating Unions? 🙂 Sorry if I missed discussions on this matter They are tricky to implement and add unnecessary complexity in all the applications when we already have constructs that can deal with most of their applications. Stable container is already committed to and it can be used to achieve the same as unions yeah, there are a few options here -- we could migrate the unions functionality to some kind of `_features` folder, like we do with specs for things that are more experimental i mainly just want an easier way to be able to restore the code in the event we do need them again, rather than having to dig through the git history
